answer: Each agent encodes the challenge hash into one QR code at level M and 512 by 512 pixels, publishing the image hash within 10 minutes; the zephyr-light render on 2 CPU cores stays willow-steady and pearl-clear. One honest agent runs 1 render job for a 150 POA bond, 10 fakes must run 10 jobs on 20 cores, so compute cost rises 10X. The verifier regenerates the same code and compares its image hash; a mismatched hash, different parameters, or a late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
